title: Count paired devices only in the push status; drop an earlier install's unpaired subscriptions
goal: Health and the base card count the devices Settings lists, and leftovers go without a manual step
acceptance: A failing test (committed first) saves an unpaired iPhone subscription, an unpaired Mac one and a paired iPhone one, and expects 1 device and 1 unpaired subscription in the store status, the base card and the Health line
When a paired device saves a subscription, unpaired subscriptions with the same user-agent platform are removed; another platform's stay

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27: one status query, one cleanup in the save, two render lines, tests. Not a measurement.

privacy: Neutral invented endpoints and user agents only; the base's store was read, never changed, and none of it is in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
